Lessons:
- WORKTREE TRAP: read/edit resolve relative paths against the SESSION cwd, which here is the old pij-f260. After #314 merged, both trees were identical, so wrong-tree reads looked fine. Use absolute paths for every read and edit.
- Identity: (kind, origin, msg_id, sender seat). jobs.dedupe_sender is a VIRTUAL generated column (payload `from`), so no INSERT changes. The ledger gained sender_seat, and '' matches any sender (the legacy brake). The store refuses deliveries with no sender, which broke about 15 `{}` and non-JSON test fixtures; fix fixtures, not the rule. carrying_enqueue's FYI attach must keep `from`.
- Decision answers (store/decisions.rs) stay cross-sender on purpose: the answer id is daemon-minted and the parent can change.
- Timing on a live-store copy: ALWAYS `rm copy.sqlite*` before re-copying. A leftover -wal from the previous run applied on top of the fresh copy and gave "database disk image is malformed". 0050 timings on the copy: debug build 2.0–2.7 s; optimised SQLite in one transaction 0.55 s.
- Cost test for "no lock taken": hold `delivery.native_lock()` and give notify a 10 s timeout in a real-time test. Don't use start_paused: sqlx waits look idle and auto-advance the clock.
